Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted the question from the outset, treating “position from 1865 to 1868” as a governmental office to look up (e.g., MP, Secretary of State) rather than the courtesy title Salisbury held in that period. This led the search toward offices like MP for Stamford/Secretary of State for India and away from the correct answer, “Viscount Cranborne” (explicitly shown in the Hansard snippet as an alternative name 1865–1868), which the Planner then repeatedly overlooked.
